defects.title: Management link in Cashier.tsx:552 gated only by reports.view; management tabs (settings, security, etc.) have no corresponding permission checks
defects.invariant: UI navigation to management screens must be gated by the same permissions that protect the backend endpoints for those screens.
defects.mechanism: Cashier.tsx:552 renders the 'Yönetim' (Management) link only when capabilities.includes('reports.view'). The link navigates to '/management'. The management-staff-roles feature (RolesPanels.test.tsx:11-18, models.ts:15-56) shows management tabs require permissions like 'settings.manage', 'security.manage', 'identity.roles.manage', 'identity.users.manage', 'integrations.manage', 'operations.backup', 'reconciliation.manage', 'reports.close-day' — none of which are checked before showing the Management link. A user with only reports.view sees the link but may not have access to any management tab content. eksik-avcisi.md:5 explicitly notes 'ayar ekranları Yönetim sekmelerinde de yok' (settings screens also not in Management tabs).
defects.source_evidence: Cashier.tsx:552; eksik-avcisi.md:5; RolesPanels.test.tsx:11-18; models.ts:15-56 (permissions list); models.ts:22 (cash.session.override label)
defects.acceptance: Management link visibility matches at least one management-tab permission (e.g., settings.manage OR security.manage OR identity.roles.manage OR identity.users.manage OR integrations.manage OR operations.backup OR reconciliation.manage OR reports.close-day), OR the link is replaced by per-tab navigation each gated by its own permission.

limitations: Read-only analysis; runtime behavior of the /management route and its child tabs not verified. The UI may perform additional permission checks inside the management page, but the top-level link exposure is already a potential information leak.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
